- Hysa is a 42-year-old who hasn't fought anyone at this level. His knockout record (23 of 25) is padded by weak opposition.
- He may suffer an early knockout, or he may survive defensively, as a similar opponent did against Fury: Mariusz Wach, 46, was stopped in round 7 in July. [Boxing News Online](https://boxingnewsonline.net/news/agit-kabayel-confronted-by-ko-artist/)

(a) **Time left:** About 30 days. The fight is on 2026-11-28 in Düsseldorf, so the result will be known that night, around 2026-11-29 00:00 UTC.

(b) **Status quo:** The fight goes ahead as scheduled and Kabayel, a heavy favourite at about -1800 to -2000, wins. His recent pattern is a mid-fight stoppage from body-punching pressure.

(c) **Base rates:**
- **Last 6 fights (since his 2022 style change):** all stoppages. Three came in rounds 1-3, two in rounds 4-6 and one in rounds 7-12.
- **Last 12 fights:** rounds 1-3: 4; rounds 4-6: 2; rounds 7-12: 1; decision: 5. The decisions all came before 2022 and carry less weight.
- **Heavyweight title fights:** a -2000 favourite in a heavyweight title fight wins roughly 92-94% of the time once the bookmaker's margin is removed.
- **Cancellations:** heavyweight bouts announced about a month out fall through roughly 5-8% of the time. The risk here is a bit higher because of September's negotiation dispute and Hysa's age.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- **Betting odds (late Oct 2026):** FanDuel has Kabayel at about -1800 and box.live at 1/20. That implies about a 93% chance he wins if the fight happens.
- **Kalshi:** Kabayel holding the WBC title on 2027-01-01 trades at 0.82. That price is illiquid but consistent with about 15-18% combined risk from an upset or other disruption.
- **Fight status:** confirmed on 2026-10-04 and moved to a 40,000+ stadium (Bild, 2026-10-28), which gives a strong commercial incentive to keep the date.
- **Hysa:** 42 years old with a 92% KO rate against weaker opposition. He knocked out Narmo in round 2 on 2026-08-29. He is likely to come forward and trade, which increases the chance of an early or mid-fight stoppage either way.
- **Opinions:** Boente (2026-10-13) picks Kabayel within five rounds, and Tapology and crowd picks overwhelmingly expect a Kabayel KO.

(e) **Unexpected outcome:** Hysa pulls out in fight week through injury, or catches Kabayel early with his power, either of which resolves to "Other". Alternatively, an aging but durable Hysa survives by clinching and the fight goes to a decision.

**Reasoning:** I started from the market's implied 93% Kabayel win chance if the fight happens, then applied about a 6% chance the fight does not take place. That gives about 87.5% for a Kabayel win overall and about 12.5% for "Other" (Hysa win, draw or no fight). I then split the Kabayel win across the round groups:
- I put the most weight on rounds 1-3 and 4-6, because Hysa's aggressive style and age make early exposure likely, and because Boente picks within five rounds.
- Rounds 7-12 get a smaller share.
- I gave decision a small share, since Kabayel has stopped all six opponents since 2022.
